title: Scorecard
description: Result of running the reviewer over a benchmark set and scoring against withheld answer keys. Field rules: data-model.md section 3.

scoring_rules_version.description: The scoring rules the scorecard was scored under (feature 014 scoring.md 8); read before the rest is validated, and a scorecard of another version is refused with the command that re-scores it. A scorecard without the field was scored under version 1

distribution.description: net_saved_minutes per package, same order as per_package

key_sha256.description: Package id to the sha256 of its answer key file's raw bytes; compare refuses a study whose runs name two digests for one package's key (feature 014 INT-16)

usage.description: session.usage.totals, copied and never re-summed; null when the session carried no usage (feature 005)

round_trips.description: session.usage.rounds: model round trips, not tool calls; null when the session carried no usage

cached_input_share.description: cached_input_tokens / input_tokens; null when either is null or input_tokens is 0. Rendered as unknown until probe L1 records that cached input is contained in input (FR-047)

wall_clock_s.description: started_at to ended_at in seconds; not unattended_runtime_minutes, which the benchmark runner overwrites with its own span. Null on a session that never ended

seconds_to_first_finding.description: First computed finding event's at minus session.started's, from events.jsonl; a finding carrying carried_over_from is skipped, since lever 11a writes carried findings during setup and timing them would measure the carry rather than the review (feature 005, FR-104); null when the run computed nothing or kept no event stream

carried_findings.description: Findings carried from an earlier run rather than computed by this one; zero unless carry_over_rms was on (feature 005, lever 11a)

unresolved_because_withheld.description: Unresolved coverage items written by a tool this run declined to offer; zero unless tool_tiers was on (feature 005, FR-054)

unresolved_other.description: Every other unresolved coverage item. Lever 4's gate is that this one must not rise. With unresolved_because_withheld it sums to coverage_bucket_mix.unresolved, never to unresolved_count, which counts findings (feature 005, FR-054)

coverage_bucket_mix.description: Coverage bucket to the number of items this run closed out in it; all five buckets are always present, zeros included, so two arms line up column for column. Lever 7 cannot be gated without it: a run that closed the checklist with skipped items looks efficient in every other column (feature 005, FR-074)

tool_calls_by_name.description: Tool name to the number of times this run called it, most called first; empty when the run called nothing. Read from session.steps, failed calls included, because the question is which tool the model picked (feature 005, T057)

matched_defect_ids.description: Detected known defects, credited or flagged, in key order (feature 014 scoring.md 3.1)

flagged_defect_ids.description: Detected through an unresolved finding only, the defect expected unresolved; within matched_defect_ids

status_mismatch_defect_ids.description: Credited by a demonstrated or suspected finding while expected unresolved; within matched_defect_ids, outside flagged_defect_ids

flagged_below_expected_defect_ids.description: Met by an unresolved finding only while expected demonstrated or suspected: not detected, in no recall figure and never a false alarm (owner decision 13A)

cleared_defect_ids.description: Matched by a checked_within_scope finding, whatever else matched

missed_defect_ids.description: Known defects no finding matched at all

contradicted_condition_ids.description: Correct conditions a demonstrated or suspected finding matched, in key order; null when the key holds none, its reason in not_assessed (feature 014 scoring.md 3.2)

confirmed_condition_ids.description: Correct conditions a checked_within_scope finding matched; null when the key holds none

false_alarm_finding_ids.description: Demonstrated or suspected findings of the final state that credit no known defect, a contradicted condition's included, in session order

finding_origins.description: Every final-state finding's origin, by finding id (feature 014 scoring.md 5.5)

graded_items.description: Every answer-key entry, in key order, as compare and the verdict read the key (feature 014 scoring.md 6)

not_assessed.description: Column name to why it is null, for every null column above and no other; never 0 (FR-021)

Origin.description: Who decided a finding was worth recording, derived from the session (feature 014 scoring.md 5.1)

producer.description: A known defect's; null for a correct condition

expected_status.description: A known defect's; null for a correct condition

recall.description: Detected over all held-out known defects of both producers, read from the answer keys' item tags, never from the set's package flag (feature 014 scoring.md 6); null with no held-out known defect

false_alarm_rate.description: false_alarms / (valid_findings + false_alarms); null if no findings

total_tokens.description: Summed over packages; null if any package contributed null, because a partial sum silently understates (feature 005)

packages_with_usage.description: How many packages contributed usage, mirroring packages_with_timing

cleared.description: The per-package defect lists' lengths, summed (feature 014 scoring.md 7)

confirmations.description: Summed over the packages whose key holds a correct condition; null when none does

recall_by_producer.description: Recall per producer and tag; a group with no known defect is null (feature 014 scoring.md 6)

held_out_model_defects.description: The held-out model-produced known defects every package's key names

TokenUsage.description: What one model round trip cost, or a sum of them, in the fields the provider actually reported. Every count is nullable because a field the endpoint omitted is unknown, not zero (feature 005, contracts/usage.md section 2). Sub-counts nest differently per provider and are never summed across them: reasoning_tokens is inside output_tokens on OpenAI and a separate addend of the total on Gemini, and tool_result_input_tokens is inside input_tokens on OpenAI and outside it on Gemini. total_tokens is the only field a cross-provider comparison may use.

cached_input_tokens.description: Contained inside input_tokens on both providers

cache_write_tokens.description: OpenAI only; null on Gemini and on an endpoint that does not report it

tool_result_input_tokens.description: Gemini only; the same tokens are already inside input_tokens on OpenAI

latency_s.description: Wall clock measured by the adapter around its own request. Never null: if we made the call, we timed it
